name: My Sweet Village
source:
You are a traveling strong magician who returns to his native village after a while. A lot has changed here after your absence. You have to explore your native land, uncover the lustful secrets that the villagers hide and improve their magical abilities.

[From [url=https://morlo.itch.io/my-sweet-village]Itch.io[/url]]
